role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, land development (Melbourne)
cover_letter_text:
Your careers page invites graduate civil engineers to send an introduction and CV, so this is a speculative enquiry about a graduate civil engineering or civil design role with your team in Hawthorn East.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records.

Estate roads, drainage and retarding basins are the civil design work I want to build a career in, and learning from Directors who work on every project, as your page describes, is a real draw. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My software experience is from study rather than commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.

I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about any graduate opening, now or later.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil design role, now or later?
